title: The Hobbit

description: A quiet hobbit joins a dangerous quest with dwarves to reclaim a lost mountain kingdom and its treasure.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: A young wizard discovers a hidden magical world, friendship, mystery, and his place in an ancient conflict.

title: Dune

title: The Martian

author: George Orwell

description: A brave teenager enters a televised survival contest and challenges an oppressive government.

title: Fahrenheit 451

description: A fireman in a society that bans books begins to question censorship, conformity, and independent thought.

title: The Da Vinci Code

description: A symbologist follows cryptic clues through art, history, secret societies, and a dangerous conspiracy.

title: Wonder

title: To Kill a Mockingbird

title: The Alchemist

title: Into the Wild
author: Jon Krakauer
description: A nonfiction account follows a young man who abandons conventional life for a journey into the wilderness.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl

title: The Design of Everyday Things
author: Don Norman
description: A classic guide to human-centred design, usability, feedback, and making products easier to understand.
